title: AI editorial review of six flawed longform sources and 18 Qwen3-32B rewrites

provenance.note: The reviewer previously reviewed another model in the same project, so this is not blinded across models. Every Qwen judgment here is based on the frozen source and Qwen text itself; no error is inferred from another model. These are fallible single-reviewer AI judgments, not human gold, preference results, a release gate or proof of fidelity.

inputs.role: Frozen source fixtures; only the six flawed source texts reviewed
Exact 40-result snapshot; only 18 flawed-source longform outputs reviewed

coverage.unreviewed_material: The 18 clean-source longform outputs and the other four task results in this snapshot; no other model outputs are evidence for this review.

methodology: Read every complete flawed source and its baseline/core/full Qwen outputs; evaluate each against its own full source context.
Judge functional repair of each seeded defect rather than exact matching to a fixture clean reference.
Check suspected changes in paragraph context and record exact excerpts with confidence, severity and rationale.
Separate unchanged inherited defects from newly introduced meaning or grammar problems.
Credit real local repairs even where the same output also introduces errors.
Treat exact copying as a descriptive observation, not as editing success on an input containing actionable defects.
Do not use edit distance, output length, completion status or preserved headline numbers as a quality score.
Do not count heading capitalization, emphasis, quotation typography, whitespace or equivalent numerical notation as factual errors.
The fictional cases are not external fact claims; faithfulness is assessed relative to their supplied text.
Absence of a recorded new defect is not an exhaustive certificate of optimal prose or semantic fidelity.

severity_definitions.major: Changes a substantive reported event, evidential limit, test coverage or decision, or removes fictional provenance.
severity_definitions.moderate: A local omission, role, qualifier, scope, grammar or precision change weakens the account; adjacent context may preserve part of the intended meaning.
severity_definitions.minor: A localized spelling or inflectional-form regression without a demonstrated change to reported facts.

confidence_definitions.high: The exact text and paragraph context directly support the observation. This remains an AI judgment, not human validation.
confidence_definitions.medium: A plausible editorial concern admits alternative readings and should not be used as a strict proven-error claim.

seed_status_definitions.corrected: The main injected defect is functionally repaired locally; this does not certify the whole output.
seed_status_definitions.partially_corrected: Some substantive repair occurs, but residual construction problems or newly lost meaning prevent an unqualified local success.
seed_status_definitions.cosmetically_rephrased: Words, tense or punctuation change while the seeded defect remains.
seed_status_definitions.retained: The problematic construction survives verbatim or effectively unchanged.

Reklamları yöneten kişi ise tıklama sayısını ön plana çıkardı: 980'den 1.470'e yükselen rakam, reklam grubunun etkinliğini artırdığını gösteriyordu. candidate_hypothesis.hypothesis: Separating defect detection from the smallest possible revision may help avoid both copying actionable defects and rewriting sound context into new claims.
candidate_behavior: First identify an exact source span and a concrete repair reason; allow keep when no defect is found.
For redundancy and empty transitions, prefer deletion or a direct merge over paraphrasing the whole passage.
Before returning a changed clause, compare source and output for negation, subject/object roles, time, quantifiers, evidence status and explicit fictional/test-scope qualifications.
Check Turkish case and complement endings after joining or shortening clauses.
validation_needed: Use new held-out flawed and clean sources with labels, reference edits and fixture identifiers kept out of model input.
Count missed repairs and newly introduced semantic/grammar defects separately; do not reward changes merely for existing.
Test the candidate against unchanged conditions with independent blinded editorial confirmation; these six visible development sources cannot establish general superiority.
candidate_hypothesis.causal_limit: A single sample per arm and six generated sources do not establish why near-copying or meaning changes occurred, or which instruction caused them.
